en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3). Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4).
16.25. Kusala-ttika, Piṭṭhiduka.
Dependent on a state that is unwholesome and to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is not unwholesome and not to be abandoned by vision, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is unwholesome and to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is not wholesome and not to be abandoned by vision, by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is unwholesome and to be abandoned by vision...
Unwholesome states that are not to be abandoned by insight and unwholesome states that are not to be abandoned by insight arise with a root condition.
(Abbreviated. Three [results] in the case of the root; ... pe ... three in the case of non-disappearance.
Conditioned by an indeterminate state that is not to be abandoned by insight, an indeterminate state that is not to be abandoned by insight arises...

A state arises by way of root condition from a state. From an indeterminate state not to be abandoned by insight as a condition, an unwholesome state not to be abandoned by insight arises by way of root condition.

From an indeterminate state not to be abandoned by insight as a condition, both an unwholesome state not to be abandoned by insight and an indeterminate state not to be abandoned by insight arise by way of root condition.
And states arise by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor to be abandoned by cultivation by way of root condition. Dependent on an unwholesome state that is to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is not wholesome and not to be abandoned by cultivation... [and so forth].

A state that is to be abandoned by means of abandoning arises by way of the root condition. Dependent on an unwholesome state that is to be abandoned by cultivation, there arise states that are neither wholesome nor to be abandoned by cultivation, and neither unwholesome nor to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of the root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are three; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are three.

Conditioned by an indeterminate state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises an indeterminate state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition], three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, three.
In dependence on an unwholesome state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, there arises an unwholesome state not rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root [condition], three; under object [condition], five; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, five.

Dependent on an unwholesome state whose root is to be abandoned by insight, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor to be abandoned by insight, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on an indeterminate state whose root is not to be abandoned by insight, there arises an indeterminate state that is neither indeterminate nor to be abandoned by insight, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on an unwholesome state whose root is to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a non-unwholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of the root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root: three; under object: five … pe … under non-disappearance: five.

Dependent on an unwholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a non-wholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: three … pe … under non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by applied thought (*savitakka*), a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by applied thought arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Thirteen under root; nine under object ... pe ... three under result ... pe ... thirteen under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a wholesome state not accompanied by applied thought (*avitakka*), a state that is neither unwholesome nor not accompanied by applied thought arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine under root ... pe ... three under result ... pe ... nine under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by sustained thought (*savicāra*), there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by sustained thought, by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are thirteen; under object condition (*ārammaṇa*) nine ... pe ... under result condition (*vipāka*) three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) thirteen.

Dependent on a wholesome state not accompanied by sustained thought (*avicāra*), there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor not accompanied by sustained thought, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are nine ... pe ... under result condition three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition nine.

Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by rapture (*sappītika*), a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are thirteen; under the object condition (*ārammaṇa*) nine ... pe ... under the resultant condition (*vipāka*) three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) thirteen.

Dependent on a wholesome state not accompanied by rapture (*appītika*), a state that is neither unwholesome nor accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are nine ... pe ... under the resultant condition three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition nine.

Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by rapture (*pītisahagata*), a non-wholesome state not accompanied by rapture arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are thirteen; under object condition there are nine … pe … under result condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are thirteen.

Dependent on a wholesome state not accompanied by rapture, a non-unwholesome state not accompanied by rapture arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are nine … pe … under result condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are nine.

Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by pleasure, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by pleasure, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Thirteen in the root [condition], nine in the object [condition] … pe … three in the result [condition] … pe … thirteen in the non-disappearance [condition].

Dependent on a wholesome state not accompanied by pleasure, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor accompanied by pleasure, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the root [condition] … pe … three in the result [condition] … pe … nine in the non-disappearance [condition].

Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by equanimity, there arises an unwholesome state not accompanied by equanimity by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are thirteen; under object condition there are nine … pe … under result condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are thirteen.

Dependent on a wholesome state not accompanied by equanimity, there arises an unwholesome state not accompanied by non-equanimity by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are nine … pe … under result condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are nine.

Dependent on an indeterminate state belonging to the sense sphere, an unwholesome state not belonging to the sense sphere arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a wholesome state not belonging to the sense sphere, an unwholesome state not belonging to the sense sphere arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Six under root, six under predominance; ... pe ... three under mutuality; ... pe ... three under result; ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a wholesome fine-material-sphere state, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor fine-material-sphere by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are six under root, six under predominance … [etc. … three under mutuality … [etc. … three under result … [etc. … six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on an indeterminate non-fine-material-sphere state, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor non-fine-material-sphere by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three under root … [etc. … three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a wholesome immaterial-sphere state, a non-wholesome state that is not of the immaterial sphere arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six in the case of root; ... pe ... six in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on an indeterminate state that is not of the immaterial sphere, an indeterminate state that is not of the immaterial sphere arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Five in the case of root; ... pe ... five in the case of non-disappearance.

Conditioned by an indeterminate, included state, an indeterminate, non-included state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five; ... pe ... under result condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are five.

Dependent on a wholesome, non-included state, a non-wholesome, non-included state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; ... pe ... under result condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Dependent on a wholesome, leading-out state, a state that is neither wholesome nor leading-out arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on an indeterminate, not-leading-out state, a state that is neither indeterminate nor not-leading-out arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a wholesome, fixed-in-destiny state, a state that is neither wholesome nor fixed-in-destiny arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six under root; ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by an indeterminate and undetermined state, an indeterminate and non-undetermined state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are five.

Conditioned by an indeterminate surpassable state, an indeterminate non-surpassable state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five; ... [and so on] ... under resultant condition there are three; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are five.

Dependent on a wholesome, unsurpassed state, a state that is neither wholesome nor unsurpassed arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.
Dependent on an unwholesome, with-protection state, a state that is neither unwholesome nor with-protection arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome, with-protection state, a state that is neither wholesome nor with-protection arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on unwholesome states that are with conflict (*saraṇa*), there arise states that are neither wholesome nor with conflict, and neither unwholesome nor with conflict, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
Dependent on indeterminate state that is without conflict (*araṇa*), there arises an indeterminate state that is not without conflict, by way of root condition.
Conditioned by an indeterminate, non-conflict state (*dhamma*), a state that is neither wholesome nor non-conflict arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Conditioned by an indeterminate, non-conflict state, states that are neither wholesome nor non-conflict and also neither indeterminate nor non-conflict arise by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are three [answers] for root; ... pe ... there are three for non-disappearance (*avigata*).
